notes.title: Melbourne International Games Week live stream
notes.content:
We're streaming Pants Quest As part of Melbourne International Games week! 

Watch one of the developers try to find their pants and make it out of the house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41609625/774f253fea021e39153c63ded006f6c5357ed646.jpg[/img]

Pants Quest will be on sale along with a new updated demo that includes the lounge room!

notes.title: It's Alive!!! New Halloween Theme
notes.content: This new update (Version 1.3.00) adds Halloween content which is visible around October 31st. It ties in thematically with the new game plus content, and happens to make the game a little more challenging as well! It can be turned off via a new toggle in the options menu. Happy Halloween!

notes.title: New Game Plus!
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that the new game plus update is now available!

After finishing the base game, there is now some additional adventuring fun. We don't want to spoil too much, but it's a little different to the basic quest for pants experience. Slightly. And it's more difficult in a classic what-do-I-put-where? kind of way.

There's a bunch of bug fixes too, ranging from a few typos to one where you could see multiples of your cat Nugget.

Thanks for your patience, we hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: New Game Plus
notes.content: We're working on a new game plus mode with some extra content and an extra side quest! We hope to have it ready for you in the next couple weeks. It will come with an update that includes a few bug fixes and additional art. We'll let you know more soon!
